**Trusted internal domains**: sensory-minds.com and its subdomains — bankhaus-metzler.sensory-minds.com, bankhaus-metzler-staging.sensory-minds.com, bhm-preprod.sensory-minds.com, agile.sensory-minds.com (YouTrack), git.sensory-minds.com
